metadata.description: Independent engineering plugins, each maintained in its own repository.

plugins.name: agent-instruction-authoring
plugins.description: Focused skill/instruction authoring and portability review, without auto-installing the result.

plugins.name: agent-role-presets
plugins.description: Configure advisor, researcher, librarian, tutor, editor, and cross-domain perspectives for a task.

plugins.name: agent-workflow-design
plugins.description: Workflow graphs, bounded coordination, comparison rubrics, and handoffs; no scheduler/runtime.

plugins.name: application-verification
plugins.description: Create and maintain application verification harnesses, exercise CLI/UI behavior, and assess performance evidence.

plugins.name: applied-learning
plugins.description: Learn technical material through focused explanation, critical questions, recall, and practical exercises.

plugins.name: code-quality-review
plugins.description: Review changes for correctness and design quality, and simplify generated code without changing required behavior.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Design, review, and refine frontend interfaces using portable Impeccable craft and platform references.

plugins.name: git-delivery
plugins.description: Optional local Git commit preparation and verification; no automatic publication.

plugins.name: grounded-communication
plugins.description: Draft and review technical communication for evidence, source fidelity, clarity, and audience fit.

plugins.name: llm-engineering
plugins.description: Prompt contracts, LLM evaluation, and RAG design.

plugins.name: ml-experimentation
plugins.description: Reproducible ML experiment plans and interpretability claim review.

plugins.name: program-management
plugins.description: Draft program charters, delivery plans, risk registers, stakeholder plans, and evidence-grounded status reports.

plugins.name: requirements-discovery
plugins.description: Clarify requirements through focused interviews, synthesize specifications, and draft stakeholder questionnaires.

plugins.name: security-assurance
plugins.description: Threat modeling, supply-chain findings, and policy-as-code review artifacts.

plugins.name: software-architecture
plugins.description: Design domain models, module boundaries, TypeScript contracts, and decision-focused prototypes.

plugins.name: systems-thinking
plugins.description: Analyze uncertain problems through evidence, first principles, system context, and bounded experiments.

plugins.name: testing-and-debugging
plugins.description: Develop features test-first, reproduce bugs, and prove regression fixes through observed behavior.

plugins.name: work-tracking
plugins.description: Canonical work graphs, ticket drafts, triage, and tracker-neutral local exports.

plugins.name: workflow-feedback
plugins.description: Connect observations, decisions, authorized actions, and outcomes into useful workflow feedback.
